description: Validate an email address before using it: syntax, whether the domain exists and accepts mail (MX records), disposable or throwaway provider detection, role addresses such as info@ or support@, free-provider detection, and SPF and DMARC presence. Returns a verdict of likely-deliverable, risky, undeliverable or invalid with reasons. No message is sent and the mail server is not contacted. Use for sign-up checks, lead list cleaning and contact enrichment. Costs $0.001 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: email
